data.one_liner: Validate JSON data against JSON Schema drafts in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart library to parse JSON Schemas and validate JSON instances. Supports synchronous and asynchronous schema creation, remote $ref fetching, and multiple Draft versions.
use_when: You need runtime validation of JSON against a schema
You work with APIs that provide JSON Schema definitions
You require platform‑agnostic validation (web, Flutter, VM)
avoid_when: You only need simple type checks (use built‑in Dart checks)
You prefer code‑generated models over runtime validation
weaknesses: Limited to validation – no schema‑based code generation
